Report: total number of qualifying events, and the distribution of the per-event counts with summary statistics (median, mean, standard deviation, min, 25th percentile, 75th percentile, max).

data.name: CypherSearch

data.content:
EcoToxFred here. Based on the graph data:

- Typical number of contributing substances (TU_algae > 0.001) at events where algae sumTU > 1: median 9 substances
- Interquartile range (25th–75th percentile): 5–13 substances
- Total qualifying events: 221
- Mean ± SD: 13.78 ± 30.71 substances
- Range: 1 to 301 substances
- Note: The distribution is right-skewed with a long tail (a few events have very many contributing substances), but most events fall near the IQR above.

Cypher query used:
MATCH (l:Site)-[sum:SUMMARIZED_IMPACT_ON]->(sp:Species {name: 'algae'})
WHERE sum.sumTU > 1
WITH l, sum.year AS year, sum.quarter AS quarter
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:MEASURED_AT]->(l)
WHERE r.year = year AND r.quarter = quarter AND r.TU_algae > 0.001
WITH l, year, quarter, count(DISTINCT s.DTXSID) AS n_substances
WITH collect(n_substances) AS counts
CALL {
  WITH counts
  UNWIND counts AS c
  RETURN count(*) AS total_events,
         min(c) AS min_count,
         percentileCont(c, 0.25) AS p25,
         percentileCont(c, 0.5) AS median,
         avg(toFloat(c)) AS mean,
         stDev(toFloat(c)) AS stdev,
         percentileCont(c, 0.75) AS p75,
         max(c) AS max_count
}
CALL {
  WITH counts
  UNWIND counts AS c
  RETURN c AS n_substances, count(*) AS frequency
}
WITH total_events, min_count, p25, median, mean, stdev, p75, max_count, n_substances, frequency
ORDER BY n_substances ASC
WITH total_events, min_count, p25, median, mean, stdev, p75, max_count,
     collect({n_substances: n_substances, frequency: frequency}) AS distribution
RETURN total_events, distribution, min_count, p25, median, mean, stdev, p75, max_count

Full database access (Neo4j Docker image): https://zenodo.org/records/14616124

If you want the full per-count frequency distribution or a breakdown by country/site or time, I can provide that next.
